query_rule
Each issued search belongs to exactly one category. Different language, market, keywords, index or personnel variants all consume that category limit; failed issued queries consume an attempt. Exact resubmission is not an effective variant and is not permitted as free retry.
read_rule
Scientific and platform observations share the 24 qualified-deep-read total per run. No separate/free platform or language pool. Original identity deduplicates across categories; failed/abstract-only/index-lead reads are recorded as attempts, not qualified full reads.
qualified_read
Original page or trustworthy original record actually accessed with publisher/author, time, applicability and exact locator. Claims cannot exceed retrieved content. Abstract-only is not full-method verification.
s2_rule
At most 2 stable typed targets with an explicit blocking gap, each at most 3 issued query variants and 6 newly qualified reads; no full S1 rescan and no transfer of unused category/target budget.

本机保存依赖当前浏览器；JSON 和离线 HTML 可另存并重新打开。所有操作留在本地，不写回原研究文件。

新建第三个主题，复用同一流程

范围、人群、市场、来源、时间窗、预算和阈值继续绑定本页唯一策略。新主题不是已完成研究；导出交接后由 Codex 按预算取证，再导入结果。

01 分支与依据支持、反证、缺口02 逐支审阅处理、纠正、理由03 方向与补证科学与兴趣各自成立04 冻结研究包原文与版本可追溯

分支覆盖与原位证据

STEP 01表象与时间线
STEP 02可能原因与鉴别边界
STEP 03可干预环节
STEP 04风险分层与见效层级

结果型：先看风险、上游原因、严重程度与持续性，再看放大因素、区分线索和改善速度。
